All nine workflows that use `actions/setup-node` set `cache: pnpm`.

In 16 sampled pull request runs, 7 restored the store (280 to 283 MB)
and 9 missed. Across 14 Unit tests runs, setup, install and the post
step took 12.9 seconds on average when the cache was restored and 18.1
seconds when it missed. Most of that gap is the post step, which tries
to save the store after a miss. Pushes to `main` missed in all 24
sampled jobs, and only 6 of those saved. The other 18 failed to reserve
the cache key. The repository holds about 10.7 GB of caches, over the
10 GB limit.

On one browser job the cache download stopped at 42 percent with an
account egress limit warning, and the install step began about nine
minutes after that warning.

Dropping the input turns the pnpm store cache off. The automatic cache
in `setup-node` only applies to
